researchProjects.title: Causal Inference in Metric Spaces via Distance Profiles
researchProjects.summary: A distance-profile framework for causal inference with object-valued outcomes in separable metric spaces.
highlights: Transformed metric-ball events into geometry-indexed binary potential-outcome contrasts.
Established pointwise identification, doubly robust/AIPW estimation, Neyman orthogonality, and finite-grid simultaneous inference.
Validated Euclidean, Wasserstein, SPD, graph, and tree-valued outcomes using connectome and network benchmarks.
researchProjects.methods: Metric spaces · AIPW · Neyman orthogonality · simultaneous inference

researchProjects.title: Relative-Belief Multiple Testing under General Additive Loss
researchProjects.summary: An extension of relative-belief asymptotic Bayes optimality under sparsity from additive 0-1 loss to general additive loss.
highlights: Derived the loss-adjusted Bayes oracle, fixed-threshold ABOS window, and risk scale.
Developed regular scale-prior threshold theory using local prior-predictive expansion.
Unified normal and uniform relative-belief rules and organized Laplace, Cauchy, and Student-t prior cases.
researchProjects.methods: Bayes oracle · ABOS · scale priors · sparse multiple testing

researchProjects.title: Survey-Based Health Risk Modeling with Interpretable Machine Learning
researchProjects.summary: An interpretable machine-learning pipeline for large-scale student health survey data.
highlights: Prepared analysis-ready questionnaire data through cleaning and feature engineering.
Built the full pipeline for imputation, stratified evaluation, six-model benchmarking, and class-imbalance handling.
Produced interpretable analyses using feature importance and SHAP outputs.
researchProjects.methods: Imputation · stratified evaluation · SHAP · class-imbalance handling

researchProjects.title: Modular Causal Meta-Learners for CATE Estimation
researchProjects.summary: A modular library of BART-based, cross-fitted CATE estimators with overlap-aware stacking.
highlights: Separated S-, X-, R-, and BCF-inspired correction principles under a common implementation.
Implemented HybridFull, an overlap-aware orthogonal-residual stacking rule with propensity-stratified simplex weights.
Evaluated the estimators across S1-S6 simulations and IHDP/JOBS benchmarks.
